hero.experience: +1 year of professional experience on a fintech SaaS.

about.p1: I am a 23 years old Developer, English B1, with +1 year of professional experience working at a fintech that facilitates access to housing in Chile, Brazil and Peru, contributing to a SaaS platform for mortgage credit management — applying SOLID principles and working with a Service-oriented architecture.
about.p2: I develop using AI-assisted workflows and modern methodologies such as Spec-Driven Development, and I'm always studying with best practices and modern technologies always focusing on clean code and engaging user interfaces.
about.p3: I'm looking for a place that brings new challenges and learning opportunities to keep growing in my career: a team where I can contribute to products with real impact, take ownerships, and sharpen my skills alongside experienced engineers.

hobbies.heading: Always exploring what's next.
hobbies.paragraph: In my free time I'm constantly testing new tools, frameworks and experiments. If something looks interesting, I build something with it.
